why: A reach objective that keeps its hint and loses its title. The hint is still authored, still in the string inventory, still translated in every language sidecar - and no player will ever see it, because the activation announcement is emitted only for a titled objective and the hint's line is nested inside that guard. That is the whole defect: a prompt that exists everywhere except on a screen, with the l10n coverage check green over it because the key is genuinely there. A non-kill objective is used deliberately, so DW0863 stays silent and this document demonstrates exactly one refusal. It declares no unit: what must not compile is the combination of a written hint and no title to carry it.
